description: This file is a shell script that defines functions for configuring, setting up, and tearing down a direct IP connection in a network interface, primarily used in a Linux-based embedded system or OpenWRT environment.

methods.name: proto_directip_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration parameters for the direct IP protocol, defining available options and defaults.

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Sets up the direct IP protocol on a specified network interface, performing device checks, PIN configuration, and starting DHCP.

methods.name: proto_directip_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the direct IP protocol, stopping ongoing processes and updating network configuration.
